scope: Stopped standard LIBERO batch, including the externally reused pilot; no API or billing-balance query performed by this analysis.

guard_price_policy.settlement: Validated usage with reconciled cache split at peak rates; otherwise all input charged as cache-miss. Off-peak discounts are not applied.

matching.method: Attempt start timestamp in the closed [run-summary.started_at_utc, run-summary.finished_at_utc] interval. Both timestamps are converted to UTC. Only a unique match is assigned.
matching.provenance_limit: Ledger has no native episode ID or retry parent ID. This is a serial temporal association, not a provider transaction-to-episode join. Missing finish times establish start association only.

usage_coverage.retry_note: HTTP attempts include initial sends and any SDK retries, but the ledger does not identify retry ordinals. Unknown reservations and attempt/model-request differences are not an exact retry count.

transcript_reconciliation.interpretation: Use ledger usage for fee reconstruction. A recorded settled response can be absent from planner aggregate usage after timeout; that is an inference about the observed difference, not proof of a retry.

assertions_passed: No duplicate JSON keys or attempt IDs
Ledger request count equals4068 unique attempts
Every settled fee reconstructs exactly from saved usage and guard peak rates
Every unknown reserve reconstructs from its original wire cap
All three ledger currency totals reconcile exactly
Each grouping conserves attempt and currency totals
